message.reasoning: The user asks: "目前比特幣價格是多少？" which means "What is the current price of Bitcoin?" They want the current price. We need to retrieve the current price. There's no function for retrieving real-time data. The only function available is database_connect_select. But we don't have a database with Bitcoin prices. We could try to use that function to query a database if we had one. But we don't have a database name or table. The user didn't provide any database. So we cannot use the function. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can say we can't retrieve it. Or we can ask for clarification. The user wants the current price. We can respond that we don't have real-time data. We can ask if they want historical data from a database. But we don't have a database. So we can politely say we don't have that data.
